findings.message: Sensitive challenge topics require export classification before release: controlled-biological-agent.
findings.remediation: Hold publication until a responsible reviewer records export-control classification or confirms the challenge is not controlled.

findings.message: Participant country list includes restricted jurisdictions: IR.
findings.remediation: Do not open the challenge to these participants until legal review approves eligibility and payout routing.

findings.message: Restricted or privacy-sensitive data types require a data-use agreement: genomic-data, clinical-trial-data.
findings.remediation: Require a signed data-use agreement before granting access to challenge data or submission workspaces.

findings.message: Cross-border participation or shared data rooms require an auditable access log.
findings.remediation: Enable immutable data-room access logging before releasing controlled datasets.

findings.message: Challenge requires NDA handling, but no NDA workflow is attached.
findings.remediation: Attach NDA routing, acceptance timestamps, and revocation steps before submissions open.

findings.message: Prize payout is configured without sanctions or payout-eligibility screening.
findings.remediation: Screen recipients before reward release and record the screening decision with the payout manifest.
